widgets_values:
PROMPT / IMAGE SOURCE — VISIBLE ATTRIBUTION

The Classic Doom 1993 Market Garden concept, opening prompt, and source image were shared by ᴊɪɢᴇɴ in Banodoco's #minimax_h3_gens on August 12, 2026:
https://discord.com/channels/1076117621407223829/1533677158067736777/1537180042210054226

The second picture is the final frame extracted from the credited generated result:
https://discord.com/channels/1076117621407223829/1533677158067736777/1537178443358142555

This repository adapts the concept into a new two-scene six-section Ref2VA demonstration. Copy both PNG files from example_workflows/assets/ into ComfyUI/input/ before loading.

nodes.title: MiniMax H3 Scene Prompt Editor — SCENE PROMPT EDITOR — STANDARD AUTHORING
Note — EXPERIMENTAL SEQUENTIAL MOTION — READ FIRST
widgets_values:
EXPERIMENTAL — sequential motion-reference timing may expose model or third-party patch interactions.

Select one motion video with embedded audio. For this two-scene plan it must become at least 464 frames at 24 fps (19.333 seconds). Reference Video Prep must remain at 464; do not trim it to one scene first.

Scene 1 uses source frames 0:243. Scene 2 uses 221:464. The repeated 22 frames intentionally match the H3 Motion Context overlap.

Keep timeline_mode = sequential and keep Current Shot.state connected to Tagged Ref2VA. restart_each_scene remains the compatibility default for ordinary reusable motion clips.

@motion and @motion_audio are weak guidance only. The Plan uses generated_audio, so the reference soundtrack is not the final assembled track.

Note — EXPERIMENTAL SEQUENTIAL MOTION — HOW TO TEST
widgets_values:
1. Copy both bundled PNG files into ComfyUI/input/.

2. Select a motion video with embedded audio lasting at least 19.333 seconds after conversion to 24 fps.

3. Keep @style_base in both scene prompts, @interior only in scene 2, and @motion + @motion_audio in both scenes. Their prompt presence is the activation mechanism; there are no numeric reference ranges.

4. Keep Current Shot state/index/count connected to Tagged Ref2VA.

5. Queue scene 1, then approve it. active_references should report @motion sequential frames 0:243, then 221:464 for scene 2.

6. Patch Priority is intentionally wired before Motion Context because this workflow exercises the experimental reference/continuation interaction.

The workflow uses the standard Scene Prompt Editor and Review Gate; no Studio-only behavior is required.

Note — RECOVERY / ASSEMBLE LATER
widgets_values:
The two amber recovery nodes are MUTED by default.

If all segments finished but final assembly did not, mute the main green Assemble node, enable both recovery nodes, and queue. They validate every SHA-256 checkpoint pair and assemble without rerendering the completed clips.

For an interrupted generation, leave recovery muted and set Loop Start's start_clip to the first unfinished clip.
